Zusammensetzung:
- **Web-Umsatz:** 26.585,60 USD (erfolgreiche Zahlungen)
- **Store-Umsatz:** 29.227,10 USD (Apple + Google Proceeds)
- **Abzug Erstattungen:** −120,00 USD (Erstattungen ohne Doppelabbuchungen)
antwort.sql:
WITH web_revenue AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.invoice_id) p.amount_usd
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.status = 'succeeded'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
),
store_revenue AS (
  SELECT st.proceeds_usd
  FROM store_transactions st
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', st.purchased_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
),
refunds_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.amount_usd) as total_refunds
  FROM refunds r
  WHERE r.reason != 'duplicate_charge'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', r.refunded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(web_revenue.amount_usd), 0) as web_revenue_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(store_revenue.proceeds_usd), 0) as store_revenue_usd,
  COALESCE((SELECT total_refunds FROM refunds_total), 0) as refunds_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(web_revenue.amount_usd), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(store_revenue.proceeds_usd), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT total_refunds FROM refunds_total), 0) as total_revenue_usd
FROM web_revenue
FULL OUTER JOIN store_revenue ON TRUE;

WITH web_revenue AS (
  -- Web-Umsatz: erfolgreiche Zahlungen, je invoice_id nur einmal
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.invoice_id)
    p.amount_usd
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.status = 'succeeded'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
),
store_revenue AS (
  -- Store-Umsatz: proceeds_usd aus store_transactions
  SELECT st.proceeds_usd
  FROM store_transactions st
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', st.purchased_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
),
refunds_total AS (
  -- Erstattungen (außer duplicate_charge)
  SELECT SUM(r.amount_usd) as total_refunds
  FROM refunds r
  WHERE r.reason != 'duplicate_charge'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', r.refunded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE = '2026-05-01'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(web_revenue.amount_usd), 0) as web_revenue_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(store_revenue.proceeds_usd), 0) as store_revenue_usd,
  COALESCE((SELECT total_refunds FROM refunds_total), 0) as refunds_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(web_revenue.amount_usd), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(store_revenue.proceeds_usd), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT total_refunds FROM refunds_total), 0) as total_revenue_usd
FROM web_revenue
